# Ahmet Can Yesildag

> Global hospitality leader with 30+ years of experience across five continents. Cornell University Hotel School alumnus (General Managers Program, Class of 2015), Skål International President, CHA-certified hospitality executive, and founder of Orophile Wellness Journeys — a boutique mountain wellness travel brand curating transformative retreats in the Dolomites, Alps, and Himalayas.
